units.characteristics: God avenging to his adversaries yet a stronghold to those who take refuge
units.gist: THE GEM - 'the LORD is a jealous and avenging God... SLOW TO ANGER and great in power, and will by no means clear the guilty'; 'WHO CAN STAND before his indignation?'; then the pivot - 'the LORD IS GOOD, A STRONGHOLD in the day of trouble; HE KNOWS THOSE WHO TAKE REFUGE IN HIM'; the same power that is terror to enemies is shelter to those who trust; 'the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace'

units.characteristics: the plundering predator's den emptied; the melting heart of terror
units.gist: the fall of Nineveh - the chariots, the palace melts, 'HEARTS MELT and knees tremble... all faces grow pale'; 'where is the LIONS' DEN?... the lion tore enough for his cubs and STRANGLED PREY... filled his caves with prey' - the insatiable predator that lived by devouring; 'BEHOLD, I AM AGAINST YOU, declares the LORD' - the predatory security emptied

units.characteristics: the bloody city of lies and plunder; violence recoiling; no one to grieve
units.gist: 'WOE TO THE BLOODY CITY, all full of LIES and PLUNDER - no end to the prey!'; the heaps of corpses from her own violence; 'I am against you... I will make you a spectacle... who will GRIEVE for her? where shall I seek COMFORTERS for you?' - violence that returns on its doer; the oppressor left with none to mourn her; 'all who hear clap their hands, for upon whom has not come your unceasing evil?'
